task_description: Fix bugs that may cause crashes or failing tests.

issues.description: Off-by-one error in calculate_average: loop range is len(numbers) + 1, causing IndexError when accessing numbers[len(numbers)]
calculate_average crashes on empty list: division by zero when len(numbers) == 0
get_element ignores the index parameter and always accesses index + 1
normalize crashes when find_max returns None (empty list): TypeError when dividing by None
find_max returns None for empty list, causing downstream failures in normalize
main() calls all functions with empty list, triggering multiple bugs
